resources.string: Vibrate mode, playing your own music

Thrum needs a motor that can change strength. Yours has one speed. Every rhythm would reach you as the same flat buzz your phone already makes, and no setting, update, or future version of this app will change that.
Thrum has to see your call notifications

It is how the app knows a call has started. Thrum checks one thing: is this a call? The rest it ignores. Nothing leaves your phone. There is no internet permission in this app and there never will be.
Pick the song you want to feel
Any track on your phone. Thrum follows the bass and drums, and makes your phone vibrate to them when someone calls.
A few seconds. Longer tracks take longer.
There is no sound in that file, so there is nothing to feel. Pick a track with music in it.
The vibration Android uses for a call on this phone: one second at full strength, then one second of silence. Play it, then play yours, and compare the two.
Your phone is on vibrate, so next time it rings, this is what you feel.
Your phone is ringing, so you will hear your ringtone and feel this. Unless they are the same file, those are two different songs.
Your phone is on silent, and Android throws the vibration away before it reaches the motor. No app can get around that.
It has to be Vibrate, not Silent. Both look like \"no sound\", but Silent means nothing vibrates at all.
Your phone is ringing and \"Also when the ringer is on\" is switched off below, so nothing vibrates.
Turn that switch on, or put your phone on vibrate.
Thrum can\'t read this phone\'s ringer setting, so it can\'t promise anything either way. It will still try when a call comes in.
%1$d steps · %2$d ms each · still %3$d%% of the time
How hard a beat lands. It also sets how far Detail can go, so raise this first if Detail runs out of room.

How long each beat is driven for. This is what decides whether a phone lying on a table moves: a longer drive pushes the table, a shorter one you only feel in your hand. Turn it up for a stronger alert, down to keep the beats crisp and separate.
0 is as close as it gets: the snare and hats come through alongside the kick, so you feel the whole pattern. Turn it up and the detail drops away until only the bare beat is left.
Changes apply straight away. Play it to feel them.
The dials can\'t change this rhythm at the moment. %1$s
The file it was built from is no longer recorded, so there is nothing to rebuild it from. Choose the song again to change the feel.
How fast can this phone tap?

Plays the same tap at six speeds, slowest first, with a pause between each. Hold the phone and notice where the taps stop feeling separate and turn into one long buzz. That speed is this phone\'s limit, and there is no point asking it for anything faster.
Also when the ringer is on
Your phone plays its own ringtone and Thrum vibrates your track over it. Unless they are the same file, you hear one song and feel another.
Thrum turns your calls, music and videos into vibrations you can feel.
Your phone\'s motor can change strength, so Thrum works here.
Thrum finds the beats in a song and plays them on your phone\'s vibration motor.
This needs no permission at all.
Anything with a beat can become something you feel.
Feel your song when someone calls, even with the ringer on.
Play the songs on your phone and feel every beat.
Feel the sound from a video.
Pick one song for calls. When your phone rings, Thrum plays its beat on the motor, with the ringer on or on vibrate.
To know a call has started, Thrum needs to see call notifications. It checks one thing: is this a call? Nothing leaves your phone.
Scan your phone\'s music in the Music tab. Then play any song in Thrum and feel every beat, from the first second to the last.
Thrum asks before it looks at your music, and it only reads music and audio files.
Pick a song for your calls, and scan your own music whenever you like.
Every haptic you make will live here, one per song, video or file. This build starts with calls.
Scanning your music arrives with the library. This build starts with calls.
Everything you can change lives on the Home tab for now.
